title: Self-serve Vendor 'Risk Wallet' — progressive evidence collection, SOC2-claims & insurance credit pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Procurement cycles for enterprise customers are slowing deal velocity because vendor risk review requires bulky questionnaire PDFs (SOC2 reports, insurance certificates, legal addenda) and ad-hoc manual verification. We want a light-weight, self-serve path that lets vendors progressively supply evidence, receive interim trust signals (SOC2-claim lite), and earn an 'insurance credit' voucher that can offset procurement insurance costs or provide prioritized onboarding.

Goal: Run a 6-week pilot with 20 existing vendor integrations (partners + marketplace suppliers) to test whether a progressive 'Risk Wallet' reduces average vendor onboarding time, reduces number of legal touchpoints, and increases conversion to Reserved/Dedicated customers by surfacing verified trust signals earlier in the procurement funnel.

Scope: MVP will include a vendor-facing portal flow (Risk Wallet), structured evidence schema, automated SOC2-claim attestation for partial evidence, issuance of insurance credit vouchers (finance-backed), audit logs for customers, and an admin dashboard for Redwood procurement/legal to accept/override claims. The pilot is limited to North America vendors and uses our existing insurance partner (InsureCo) for credit issuance.

Key success metrics (pilot):
- Reduce median vendor onboarding time from 18 days to <= 7 days for pilot cohort.
- Decrease legal review handoffs per vendor from avg 3 to <=1.
- 25% faster procurement approval for pilot vendors.
- >60% of pilot vendors successfully claim at least one insurance credit voucher.

Non-goals: This is not a full SOC2 audit automation, not an insurer risk underwriting change, and not a universal policy for all geographies in this pilot phase.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Vendor can create a Risk Wallet and upload structured evidence (SSPs, attestation statements, cert images, KYC docs). 2) System issues 'SOC2-claim (lite)' when minimum evidence schema satisfied and logs an auditable claim with timestamp and evidence IDs. 3) Finance integration returns a signed insurance credit voucher code that can be applied to procurement invoices. 4) Admin UI shows per-vendor verification status, evidence list, and has actions: Accept Claim, Request More Evidence, Revoke Voucher. 5) All evidence & voucher issuance events are stored in immutable audit logs and accessible to customer security reviewers via read-only download. 6) End-to-end flow covered by E2E tests and a security review signoff.

2026-02-15 — Maya Chen (Design): Uploaded initial flows to Figma (see attachment). UX decision: progressive disclosure of evidence steps to avoid drop-off; optional 'fast-track' for vendors with existing SOC2 reports.
Feedback: add inline examples for each evidence field and a preview of the voucher redemption process.

2026-02-17 — Jordan Alvarez (Legal): High-level signoff on SOC2-claim wording for 'lite' attestation. Legal requires the claim text include: 'Attested by Redwood Inference based on vendor-submitted evidence; not a substitute for independent audits.' Legal asked for an override flag for final human review.

2026-02-18 — Eng sync: Backend (Priya) estimates 6 backend sprints (8 pts) for evidence ingestion, claim generator, voucher integration. Frontend (Egor) estimates 3 sprints for portal UI and admin dashboard. Agreed to cut scope: no multi-tenant SSO in MVP — vendors will use invite links.

2026-02-20 — Security (Ravi): Security checklist added. Requirement for KMS integration for document-at-rest encryption and access controls; must pass security review. Scoped threat modelling — risk of forged evidence mitigated by signature verification and manual spot checks for pilot vendors.

2026-02-22 — Finance (Leah): Confirmed integration path with InsureCo sandbox; voucher accounting requires a ledger entry and monthly reconciliation workflow. Finance requested voucher TTL (we propose 90 days) and cap per vendor (pilot cap = $10k).

2026-02-24 — Luca: Engineering spike started — proof-of-concept to validate automated claim issuance with hashed evidence IDs and signed voucher tokens. Design to iterate on success messaging for vendors. Scheduled stakeholder demo for 2026-03-09.

2026-02-25 — Aisha: Updated success metrics to include legal handoff reduction and voucher redemption rate. Added PM owner for metrics (Aisha) and analytics event list for instrumentation (events: wallet_created, evidence_uploaded, claim_issued, voucher_redeemed, admin_override).
